name: catalog_audit_events
description: Append-only record of catalog, schema, record and price changes, with the acting member and the branches each change concerns.
lifecycle: Inserted in the same transaction as the change it records; never updated or deleted at runtime. Retention follows the company (provisional until PH-13).

columns.Meaning: Catalog the event concerns; not a foreign key, so events outlive deleted catalogs.
Record the event concerns; not a foreign key.
columns.Null meaning: The event concerns the catalog or its schema.

columns.Meaning: Branches the change concerns, for branch-scoped audit reads; empty for company-wide changes.
columns.Null meaning: Never null; an empty array means the change is company-wide.

columns.Meaning: Membership through which the change was made.
Event name such as catalog.created, catalog.schema_changed, catalog.record_updated, catalog.price_changed, catalog.price_override_changed or catalog.promotion_changed.
Bounded summary: names, field identifiers, counts, versions, IDs, and old and new amounts with their currency for price events; never record values.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (actor_principal_id) REFERENCES principals(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The actor is a known principal.
The branch list is present and bounded.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, actor_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The acting membership belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: An event belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX catalog_audit_events_catalog_idx ON public.catalog_audit_events USING btree (company_id, catalog_id, occurred_at DESC, id DESC)
constraints.Purpose: Reads a catalog's history newest first.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalog_audit_events_company_id_id_key ON public.catalog_audit_events USING btree (company_id, id)
